name: multi-select
title: Multi-select
description: Pick several options from a dropdown; the choices show as removable tags, with an optional select-all.

when: Several choices from a medium list.

instead.when: A few options should all stay visible.

builtIn: Each tag has a remove button named after its option.
Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.

genui.description: A dropdown for several choices shown as tags. items are {id, label}. Emits change.
